settings.brand.title: Brand
settings.brand.lead: Upload logo and favicon used on splash, login, and the sidebar. Set the welcome-page logo circle color.
settings.brand.logo_lead: Logo — max 300×300 px, 500 KB (PNG, JPEG, GIF)
settings.brand.favicon_lead: Favicon — max 16×16 px, 500 KB (PNG, JPEG, GIF)
settings.tanks.title: Tanks
settings.tanks.lead: Fermentation tanks used when scheduling a batch. Soft-disable tanks you do not want booked.
settings.multipliers.title: Multipliers
settings.multipliers.lead: Price multipliers selected on Delivery. Net = beer net {currency}/L × multiplier × delivery liters (tax is not multiplied).
settings.suppliers.title: Suppliers
settings.suppliers.lead: Purchase vendors and cost adjustments. Effective cost = base cost × (1 + adjust % / 100). Applied to inventory display and when recipes or orders snapshot cost.
settings.beer_price.title: Beer net price
settings.beer_price.lead: Default beer net {currency}/L prefilling the Delivery form. Multiplier is applied on top when calculating net.
settings.regional.title: Regional
settings.regional.lead: Currency, language, tax jurisdiction, and gravity unit used across the app.
settings.hygiene.title: Hygiene routines
settings.hygiene.lead: Master list of hygiene routines shown when confirming brewday cleaning.
settings.backup.title: Backup
settings.backup.lead: Automatic backup every night at 01:00. Keeps 7 daily and 3 monthly copies. Manual backups are kept for 90 days.
settings.demo.title: Demo data
settings.demo.lead: First-run sample brewery and batches that show every pipeline step. Purge removes that demo brewery, its batches, demo tanks, and reverts demo inventory top-ups.
inventory.lead: Shared stock across all breweries. Cost price is the base inpris; supplier adjust % is applied for batch cost and orders.
orders.title: Orders
orders.lead: Build a planning order, mark it ordered, then complete it to receive stock into inventory.
orders.product_links_lead: Open supplier product pages while ordering. Managers can save links to the inventory catalog.
recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.lead: Create a batch and check out available stock; missing amounts go to a planning order. Delete restores stock while the batch is created or scheduled. Delivered batches can be hidden instead of deleted.
recipes.shortfall_lead: Available stock was checked out. Missing amounts were added to a planning order.
schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.lead: Book a brew day and fermentation tank for a created recipe. Moves the batch to scheduled.
brewday.title: Brewday
brewday.lead: After scheduling: record OG and brew volume to complete brewday. Confirm hygiene when cleaning is done. Edit reloads the form (revokes hygiene if needed). Revoke brewday returns the batch to scheduled.
hygiene.title: Hygiene routines
hygiene.lead: Primary path after brewday: check off cleaning routines per batch (or confirm all). Moves the batch to hygiene done so delivery can begin.
delivery.title: Delivery batches
delivery.lead: After hygiene: set FG, delivery volume, beer net {currency}/L, and multiplier. Net = beer net × multiplier × liters; alcohol tax is fixed and separate. Calculate & ready, then deliver to the pub.
economy.tax.title: Tax and VAT
economy.tax.lead: Beer excise for the active tax jurisdiction. Used on delivery; small-producer discounts by annual volume where applicable.
economy.tax.es_bands_note: Spain uses fixed ABV/°Plato bands (2026). Rates are built into the calculator.
economy.deliveries.title: Monthly deliveries
economy.deliveries.lead: List delivered batches for a month with volume, ABV, tax, net, and estimated profit (net − cost) for tax declaration and invoicing. Download CSV for export.
iam.users.title: Users
iam.users.lead: Create and edit users (user, superuser, admin). Optionally attach a brewery when creating a user.
iam.users.role_hint: You cannot change your own role away from admin.
iam.breweries.title: Breweries
iam.breweries.lead: Create and edit breweries, contacts, logo, and members. Remove a brewery only if it has no delivered batches.
iam.breweries.logo_lead: Logo — max 300×300 px, 1 MB (PNG, JPEG, GIF)
guide.title: Brewery 101
guide.lead: How to take a batch from recipe to the pub, what roles mean, and what each section of Brewhouse is for.
guide.pipeline_lead: Follow these steps in order. Each step advances the batch status.
guide.steps.recipes: Create a batch and pick ingredients. Available stock is checked out; shortfalls go to a planning order.
guide.steps.schedule: Book a brew day and a fermentation tank.
guide.steps.brewday: Record original gravity (OG) and brew volume, then mark brewday completed.
guide.steps.hygiene: Confirm cleaning is done for the batch (or use Hygiene done on Brewday).
guide.steps.delivery: Set final gravity (FG), delivery volume, beer net {currency}/L, and multiplier. Live estimate shows tax (fixed), net (= beer net × multiplier × liters), and estimated profit (net − cost). Click Calculate & ready.
guide.steps.deliver: On Delivery, click Deliver to mark the batch as sent to the pub.
guide.admin_lead: Admin accounts sign in as superuser. Tax rates, IAM Users, and Settings stay hidden until you elevate. Monthly deliveries also appear for brewery managers without elevate.
guide.admin.where_text: Open the profile menu (avatar, top right) and use the Admin mode toggle. Only admin accounts see it.
guide.admin.on_text: Your session becomes admin; tax rates, IAM, and Settings appear in the navigation.
guide.admin.off_text: You return to superuser; admin-only pages are left and those nav sections hide again.
guide.roles_lead: Access has two layers: the account role on the user (IAM → Users), and a brewery membership role per brewery (IAM → Breweries).
guide.account.user: Brewing, Inventory (view), and Hygiene for breweries you belong to: recipes, schedule, brewday, delivery, and wishlist shortfalls from recipes.
guide.account.superuser: Same as user, plus create and edit shared inventory and purchase orders. Tax settings and IAM Users stay behind Admin mode; monthly delivery reports are available when you manage a brewery.
guide.account.admin: Signs in as superuser. With Admin mode on, full access including tax settings, IAM Users, and Settings.
guide.membership.user: Member of that brewery; can work on its batches.
guide.membership.superuser: Member plus inventory management for the shared stock; can view monthly delivery reports for that brewery.
guide.membership.brewery_admin: Manages that brewery (contacts, logo, and members) and can view its delivery reports. Not a global admin, and not set as the account role in Users — only on membership.
guide.roles_footer: Tax rates and Settings require elevated admin (see Admin mode). Monthly deliveries are visible to elevated admin and to brewery managers (membership superuser / brewery_admin). IAM → Breweries is available to brewery managers for their brewery; Users stays admin-only.
guide.brewing.recipes: Create and manage batches; inventory checkout and planning shortfalls.
guide.brewing.brewday: Enter OG and brew volume; edit or revoke brewday.
guide.brewing.delivery: Price and deliver hygiene-done batches to the pub; live estimate includes estimated profit (net − cost).
guide.inventory.stock: Shared stock. Cost price feeds batch cost.
guide.inventory.orders: Plan purchases, mark ordered, complete to receive stock.
guide.hygiene.routines: Confirm brewday cleaning so the batch can go to delivery.
guide.tools.calculators: ABV from SG, alcohol tax (active jurisdiction), DME/LME to raise gravity, water to dilute to a target SG, yeast pitch rate (from Inventory → Yeast items with pitch fields set), and CO₂ carbonation (temp + pressure ↔ volumes).
guide.economy.tax: Beer excise for the active tax jurisdiction, used on delivery.
guide.economy.deliveries: Delivered batches by month with cost, tax, net, and estimated profit (CSV export).
guide.iam.users: Create and edit accounts and roles (admin).
guide.iam.breweries: Breweries, contacts, logo, and memberships. Brewery managers can edit their brewery and upload a logo (max 300×300, 1 MB).
guide.settings.multipliers: Options that scale beer net {currency}/L on delivery.
guide.settings.suppliers: Vendors and percentage adjustments applied to inventory cost price.
guide.settings.regional: Currency, language, tax jurisdiction, and gravity unit used across the app.
guide.settings.hygiene: Master checklist used when confirming hygiene.
guide.settings.backup: Nightly database backups at 01:00, download, and restore.
tools.title: Calculators
tools.lead: Quick brewing helpers for ABV, alcohol tax, extract additions, dilution, yeast pitch, and CO₂ carbonation. Results update as you type.
tools.abv.title: ABV from SG
tools.tax.title: Alcohol tax
tools.tax.lead: Uses current tax settings for the active jurisdiction ({currency}/L × volume).
tools.extract.title: Extract to raise SG
tools.extract.lead: How much DME or LME to add to reach a higher SG. DME ≈ 370 points·L/kg (~44 PPG); LME ≈ 300. Volume is assumed unchanged after dissolving. Rule of thumb: ~27 g DME per +0.001 SG in 10 L.
tools.dilute.title: Water to lower SG
tools.dilute.lead: Dilution by gravity-point conservation: final volume = current × (current SG − 1) / (wanted SG − 1).
tools.pitch.title: Yeast pitch rate
tools.pitch.lead: Dry yeast dosing by volume (g/hl) from Inventory → Yeast items with pitch fields configured. Choose Low / Mid / High within the strain’s range. 1 hl = 100 L.
tools.co2.title: CO₂ carbonation
tools.co2.lead: Force-carbonation volumes from keg temperature and regulator pressure, or required pressure for a target volume. Style bands follow common keg charts.
tools.co2.target_lead: Pressure needed for a target carbonation level at the same temperature.
